title: 第22章 你最近和清妍有联系吗？
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
对于这个有灵性的空格，李清妍给出的评价是——拙劣的小花招儿！

    但却让她感到愉悦。

    好朋友之间，开这样的小玩笑不是很正常吗？

    还有，她只是提到身体不舒服，对方就猜到她是大姨妈来了，还让她多喝红糖姜茶，这份细腻和贴心，不是好朋友能做得到吗？

    ‘提到烧烤，我刚刚吃完烧烤回来，那叫一个香！你什么时候再回常青，我请你啊！【笑脸】’

    ‘承蒙关心，原本工作还算顺利，也不算太忙，但从明天开始，我的好日子就到头了。我刚刚被抓去当县委书记联络员，明儿一早还要陪书记到市里开会……【叹气】’

    ‘我就不问你了，因为我知道考研对于李清妍同学而言，就四个字——轻而易举。我觉得吧，像你这种温柔耐心的性子，应该很适合当老师。【龇牙笑】’

    李清妍看完对方最后一句回复，心弦不禁为之一颤。

    连她考研之后留校当老师的想法，他都能猜得到吗？

    与梁惟石聊天的这些日子，她越发地感觉到，在她的生命之中，从来没有人像他一样，如此懂她！

    ……

    第二天一早，还没等闹钟铃声响起，梁惟石就已经醒了过来。

    关掉闹钟，下床洗漱，用热水冲了杯豆奶，吃了两块饼干，然后对着镜子整理了下衣着。

    按照昨天的约定，宋启贤的司机许斌会在早上六点半左右过来接他。

    梁惟石看了眼时间，还差五分钟六点半，就是这一抬眼的功夫，他的手机忽然响了起来。

    电话是许斌打来的，通知他可以下楼了。

    梁惟石走出楼门口，就看见一辆本田雅阁停在道旁，他连忙小跑两步过去，开门坐进了副驾驶。

    “许哥早。”梁惟石礼貌地打了声招呼。

    许斌友善地点了点头，虽然他是宋书记的司机，而且颇得宋书记信任，但他很清楚，眼前这个年轻人是县委办刘主任极力推荐过来的，而且刚参加工作就能被宋书记选中成为联络员，背景肯定不一般。

    他完全没必要和人家摆什么架子。

    更何况司机和秘书，都是领导身边人，相互之间只有和谐相处，才能更好地为领导服务嘛。
content_en:
Regarding this spiritual space, Li Qingyan's evaluation was - a clumsy little trick!

    But it made her feel happy.

    Isn't it normal for good friends to make little jokes like this?

    Also, when she just mentioned that she wasn't feeling well, the other party guessed that her aunt was here and asked her to drink more brown sugar and ginger tea. Isn't this kind of delicate and considerate that a good friend can do?

    ‘Speaking of barbecue, I just came back from having barbecue, it was so delicious! When will you come back to Changqing? I invite you! [Smiley face]’

    ‘Thanks to your concern, my work was going smoothly and I wasn’t too busy, but starting from tomorrow, my good days will come to an end. I was just arrested to be the liaison officer of the county party committee secretary, and I have to accompany the secretary to the city for a meeting tomorrow morning... [Sigh]'

    ‘I won’t ask you anymore, because I know that for Li Qingyan, the postgraduate entrance examination is just four words – a piece of cake. I think someone with a gentle and patient temperament like yours should be very suitable for being a teacher. [Baring teeth and smiling]’

    After Li Qingyan read the last reply from the other party, her heartstrings couldn't help but tremble.

    Could he even guess her intention to stay in school and become a teacher after taking the postgraduate entrance examination?

    During these days of chatting with Liang Weishi, she felt more and more that no one in her life had ever understood her as well as he did!

    …

    Early the next morning, Liang Weishi woke up before the alarm clock rang.

    I turned off the alarm clock, got out of bed, washed up, made a cup of soy milk with hot water, ate two biscuits, and then straightened my clothes in front of the mirror.

    According to yesterday's agreement, Song Qixian's driver Xu Bin would come to pick him up around 6:30 in the morning.

    Liang Weishi glanced at the time. It was still five minutes to six-thirty. Just as he raised his eyes, his cell phone suddenly rang.

    The call was from Xu Bin, informing him that he could go downstairs.

    When Liang Weishi walked out of the building, he saw a Honda Accord parked on the side of the road. He quickly jogged over, opened the door and got into the passenger seat.

    "Good morning, Brother Xu." Liang Weishi greeted politely.

    Xu Bin nodded kindly. Although he was Secretary Song's driver and was trusted by Secretary Song, he knew very well that the young man in front of him was highly recommended by Director Liu of the County Party Committee Office, and he was selected as a liaison officer by Secretary Song just after he started working. His background must be extraordinary.

    There is absolutely no need for him to put on airs with others.

    What's more, drivers and secretaries are all close to the leader. Only by living in harmony with each other can they serve the leader better.
title_en: Chapter 22 Have you been in contact with Qingyan recently?
